capabilities: Register arbitrary file extensions as Markdown
Render Markdown syntax in files with non-.md extensions
Index non-md files as native Markdown (experimental)
disambiguation: Only files containing Markdown syntax are supported; embedded JSX blocks or R code are not specially handled or rendered.
extras: The experimental indexing feature overrides built-in Obsidian logic; the author offers no support or guarantees for it.
intentEvidence: It will also allow Obsidian to index non-md files as though they are .md. This overrides some built-in logic.
problem: Obsidian only recognizes .md files, so Markdown-syntax files with other extensions are invisible and unsearchable in the vault.
summary: Lets users register any file extension (mdx, qmd, rmd, etc.) so Obsidian treats those files as Markdown.
